title: How to Make a YouTube End Screen Gizmo
content: In the last 20 seconds of a YouTube video, you can offer the viewer the chance to click on other videos, playlists, websites, or the Subscribe button, using their "end screen" options.In this behind-the-scenes video I show how to make a reusable gizmo to make that end screen segment more interesting and to encourage viewers to click those links. (Link to video on YouTube).The panels flip into position before being superimposed with the link options. The movement of the panels is powered by mousetrap springs. It's cheap and easy to build, and it's completely customizable to the style of your channel.Materials:Mousetraps,1 " X 3 " Pine boardsscrew eyesMagic Sculpt epoxy clayGorilla glueMy next Gumroad tutorial, "Flower Painting in the Wild," comes out this Friday, August 18.
